prompt: Create a premium game UI background illustration for a friendly dinosaur side-view action-platformer titled in the project as Dinosaur Rift. WIDE LANDSCAPE composition 16:9, no text or lettering, no logos, no interface, no dinosaurs or characters. A cinematic prehistoric jungle valley at sunrise: layered misty teal cliffs and distant waterfalls, elegant palm and fern silhouettes framing only the left and right outer edges, a warm amber shaft of light over a calm open middle area. Polished pre-rendered HD cartoon art with physically believable soft lighting and detailed leaf material, rich dark jungle greens balanced with light mist. Most of the central 65 percent must be quiet, uncluttered low-contrast atmosphere so an interface title and selectable panels can be laid on top. Upper corners and bottom edge should be darker for cream text readability. No foreground platforms, spikes, gameplay collectibles, UI buttons or borders baked into the image. A single complete background suitable for a game home menu; not a sprite sheet and not a mockup. High quality cohesive illustration, no blurry patches, no tiny incidental objects.
